svg.aria-label: How a stop by wsl-spawner compares with wsl --shutdown and with docker stop. wsl --shutdown gives no service its time to stop and cuts containers mid-write; they come back only by their restart policy; it does not run at sign-out and keeps no record. docker stop gives only containers their time and marks them stopped by hand, so one with unless-stopped no longer starts and only those with always come back; it does not run at sign-out and keeps no record. wsl-spawner gives each service and container its own time, keeps their policies, brings back the containers you choose, runs last as Windows signs out, and says how each stop went in history and check.
